name: Gray Worm AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

generalAbilities.name: Blood Scent
generalAbilities.description: The gray worm can smell blood in the air from up to 1 mile away, or in the earth from up to 1,000 feet away.

defensiveAbilities.name: Inexorable
defensiveAbilities.description: The gray worm recovers from the Paralyzed, Slowed, and Stunned conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the Immobilized condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shake It Off
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The gray worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as Cursed Metamorphosis)

Effect The gray worm negates the triggering condition or effect. Effects from artifacts, deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living creature hit by a gray worm's stinger Strike must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thrash
offensiveAbilities.description: The worm makes a Strike once against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
